components.text: Hi {{1}}. This is Lead Velocity, who run SortMyCover. On {{2}} some of your details (your name, mobile number and the cover enquiry answers you gave) were shown on a public web page by mistake. We took it down at {{3}} and have no sign that anyone misused them. Please be careful with unexpected messages that mention your enquiry, and never share a code or PIN. We have told the Information Regulator. If you have questions, want to object, or want your details deleted, write to {{4}}. We are sorry. Reply STOP to opt out.
